Grand Theft Auto 6 is the "first game played on 70% of new PS5 consoles" GTA 6 isn't just smashing records as the highest-rated game of all time on Metacritic – it's also apparently surpassing massive milestones on consoles like the PlayStation 5. So much so, in fact, that Sony now reports Rockstar's long-awaited new Grand Theft Auto is the "biggest launch in PlayStation history" – ever, ever. That's a nearly 32-year-long history. The company reveals as much in a new blog post, writing, "The launch of GTA 6 marks an extraordinary moment for gaming and entertainment, becoming the biggest game launch in PlayStation history, across three decades and five console generations." Sony goes on to specify just how many players constitute "the biggest" release: "More than 39 million unique players have experienced Jason and Lucia's story in Grand Theft Auto 6 on PlayStation 5." Nearly 40 million. "GTA 6 set a new record for the highest number of concurrent players for any game on PlayStation, surpassing previous records across multiplayer, free-to-play, and single-player titles." That's no small feat, considering this includes… well, everything. From online games like Fortnite to more recent single-player launches like Ghost of Tsushima sequel Ghost of Yotei – and everything before them on every single PlayStation system to date. And, it appears folks helping set this record on PS5 are actually spending quite a bit of time in Grand Theft Auto 6 as well… not just purchasing it. "Across PS5, players cumulatively logged an incredible 683 million hours of gameplay in GTA 6," as Sony writes," reflecting the enthusiasm of the PlayStation community. Each player has spent an average of 17.4 hours exploring the state of Leonida during the game's opening days." That's not bad, considering just how behemoth-like Rockstar seems. It's only been a few days, and the community is clearly engaging with it. GTA 6 is boosting console sales, too. titre: GTA 6 Was Biggest Launch in PlayStation History
chapo: Now that the dust has somewhat settled after the avalanche that was the launch of GTA 6, PlayStation has revealed some of its stats from the game, revealing that this was the single largest game release in PlayStation history.
extrait: Now that the dust has somewhat settled after the avalanche that was the launch of GTA 6, PlayStation has revealed some of its stats from the game, revealing that this was the single largest game release in PlayStation history. PlayStation’s November 23 blog post states that more than 39 million unique players have played the game on the PlayStation 5, setting a new record for the highest number of concurrent players for any PlayStation game. This beats out other records for multiplayer games, single-player games, and perhaps most astonishingly, even free-to-play titles. On top of that, GTA 6 players logged a total of 683 million hours played in the game, with the average player spending an estimated 17.4 hours sticking up virtual pawn shops and stealing NPC’s cars during its first few days. What’s more impressive is the sheer amount of people who purchased PS5s specifically to play GTA 6. PlayStation’s blog says it saw the “largest number of newly-connected PS5 consoles on a single day” since the console’s launch in November 2020, not counting end-of-year holidays like Christmas. Since GTA 6’s launch, it was the first game played on 70% of these new consoles. GTA 6 has, perhaps unsurprisingly, broken a slew of big records. The most prominent of these is its status as the biggest entertainment launch of all time, with Rockstar reporting that the game earned $3.79 billion in its first 24 hours. On top of this, internet provider Comcast said that GTA 6’s launch day was its highest-traffic day ever, with 24% of all its internet traffic during peak times coming from users downloading and playing Rockstar’s latest offering. Xbox had its own big records, too; Xfinity, which is under the Comcast umbrella, said GTA 6 increased the internet traffic on Xbox consoles by four times the normal amount this November. People are still making new discoveries in this game, and there’s bound to be many more that pop up over the next few months. GTA 6 is up for eight awards at The Game Awards and has enjoyed massive critical reception, with IGN scoring it a glowing 10 out of 10 — the title of ‘Masterpiece.’ Reviewer Luke Reilly praised the game for being “exquisitely detailed, endlessly ripe for experimentation, and uncompromisingly engineered,” saying “Grand Theft Auto 6 is the single most impressive video game I have ever played.” It’s unlikely that we see a game release as big as this one, with such a massive cultural impact, ever again. titre: GTA 6 was the ‘biggest launch in PlayStation history’ with over 39 million players
extrait: Grand Theft Auto 6 was “the biggest launch in PlayStation history,” according to Sony, with over 39 million users playing the game on PS5. According to a post on the PlayStation blog, players cumulatively logged 683 million hours of gameplay in GTA 6 between launch and November 22. The game also set a new record for concurrent players of a single game on PlayStation consoles. PlayStation also claims that the platform holder “saw the largest number of newly connected PS5 consoles on a single day since the consoleâs launch, outside of end-of-year holidays.” GTA 6 was also “the first game played on 70% of new PS5 consoles” during the period of launch until November 22. This comes after Rockstar and publisher Take-Two announced that Grand Theft Auto 6 has become the most successful launch for any piece of media in history, after being pre-ordered over 32 million times. On Friday, Rockstar and Take-Two claimed that the game has generated $3.79 billion in day one retail sales, “setting a new record for entertainment across any medium, and becoming the biggest entertainment launch in history.” For comparison, Spider-Man: Brand New Day generated $2.5 billion across its entire theatrical run as the highest grossing film of the year. When compared to other GTA titles, GTA 5 generated $815 million on launch day, which means GTA 6 managed almost 5 times as much. Grand Theft Auto 6 released on Thursday November 19, 13 years after the previous entry in the franchise. Upon release, the game achieved a record-tieing 99 out of 100 on Metacritic, making it one of the highest rated games of all time. VGC’s Grand Theft Auto 6 review calls it “the game of the generation”, saying Rockstar “delivers its modern masterpiece with a remarkable artistic achievement that exceeds all expectations”.
